intro: Questions that must be answered before a sound decision can be made. Each row shows what is known, what is missing, and how to find out. Status: answered = confirmed from an official source; partial = part confirmed; unanswered = no confirmed answer yet.

questions.question: Which Amazon listing was each submitted short link meant to point to?
questions.known: Each short link resolves to a different /dp/ page. The observed ASINs are B0CDY277D3, B09B7SB46R, B08DKYBTPH, B0DHZTCNR5, and B0DZFD6R9Z (SRC-11..15).
questions.missing: The intended ASIN for each product. No intent was supplied.

questions.question: Are the submitted short links Special Links that credit the Associate tag shopnow047c-20?
questions.known: No observed redirect URL contains a tag parameter. Participation Requirements §2(a)–(b) require the tag on each Special Link.
questions.missing: Whether the links carry the tag in a form not visible in the redirect. Whether the tag is enrolled.

questions.question: Is tracking ID shopnow047c-20 enrolled and active in Associates Central?
questions.known: The ID was supplied in the brief.
questions.missing: Enrollment status. Requires your Associates Central login.

questions.question: What is the standard commission rate for each product category?
questions.known: Commission is a percentage of qualifying revenue (SRC-02, Commission Income Statement §3). The rate table is not readable without sign-in.
questions.missing: The rate for Home & Kitchen and any subcategory.

questions.question: How much commission could each product earn?
questions.known: Commission is paid on qualifying revenue after deductions for shipping, taxes, and similar items (SRC-02, Commission Income Statement §1). A session lasts 24 hours from the click, and an order counts if placed within 89 days (SRC-02, §1(b)).
questions.missing: Rate (Q-04). Price (Q-06). Order volume (Q-07). Without these, no revenue estimate is made.

questions.question: What are the current prices and availability?
questions.known: Prices appeared on the listings. Display is restricted by Participation Requirements §2(b).
questions.missing: A permitted source for display: Amazon-served link, PA-API, or Creators API.

questions.question: Which products sell or convert well?
questions.known: No sales, click, or order data is available. The campaign ledger is empty.
questions.missing: Authorised first-party reports (Associates reports or site analytics).

questions.question: Do people search for the question-shaped guide topics?
questions.known: The four topics are editorial hypotheses supplied in the brief. They are not claims about popularity or search volume.
questions.missing: Search-demand data. No keyword source has been verified.

questions.question: Which guides bring readers who click through?
questions.known: The site has an outbound-click event and a guide-read event, both defined and tested in code. They are not live.
questions.missing: A running endpoint that receives events.

questions.question: What disclosure wording and placement are required?
questions.known: Operating Agreement §5 requires 'As an Amazon Associate I earn from qualifying purchases.' to be stated clearly and prominently (SRC-01). FTC guidance says to place a disclosure so it is 'hard to miss', and warns that disclosures are likely to be missed on an About Me or profile page, at the end of posts, or behind a click to see more (SRC-05).
questions.missing: A reviewer's sign-off on placement (strip under masthead and footer).

questions.question: Is this site's URL the one listed in the Associates application?
questions.known: Participation Requirements §1 requires the site to be publicly available at the address in the application (SRC-02).
questions.missing: The address in the application.

questions.question: Who operates the site, and what privacy policy applies?
questions.known: The site sets no cookies and sends no data unless an endpoint is configured. Participation Requirements §3(e) requires accurate disclosure of tracking (SRC-02).
questions.missing: Operator's legal name, contact address, and final privacy policy.

questions.question: What is the site's brand name?
questions.known: The working name is 'The Countertop Guide'.
questions.missing: A confirmed name and trademark check.

questions.question: Who is the named author of each guide?
questions.known: No author was supplied.
questions.missing: Author identity, credentials, and bio.

questions.question: Can product photos be used on the site?
questions.known: Program Content may be used only as the Associates terms allow (Participation Requirements §6(a), §6(d)) (SRC-02).
questions.missing: A clearance decision. No photos are used.

questions.question: Where should the analytics endpoint run?
questions.known: GitHub Pages serves static files only (SRC-08). The collector is written and tested.
questions.missing: A host you control, or an approved vendor.

questions.question: Are the five events in the brief the ones you intended?
questions.known: The brief refers to five defined events without listing them. A proposed set is in place.
questions.missing: Your event definitions.

questions.question: How often should new guides be published?
questions.known: The site proposes two guides a month. Nothing confirmed.
questions.missing: Your choice of cadence.

questions.question: Are the manufacturer claims in listing titles accurate?
questions.known: Titles include claims such as '±0.5℉ Accuracy', 'NIST&NSF Certified', 'IP67 Waterproof', and '450°F Hi-Fry Option'. They are labelled as manufacturer claims.
questions.missing: Independent confirmation from the certifying body or manufacturer documents.

questions.question: What internal temperatures does the USDA set as minimums?
questions.known: Answered. Beef, pork, veal, and lamb steaks, chops, and roasts: 145°F with a rest of at least 3 minutes. Ground meats: 160°F. Poultry: 165°F. Fish and shellfish: 145°F. Leftovers: 165°F (SRC-07).
questions.missing: None for the guide's scope.

questions.question: Do limited-time promotions affect what the site can say?
questions.known: Participation Requirements §2(b) requires removal of any mention of a promotion when it ends (SRC-02).
questions.missing: A promotion calendar. None is used.

questions.question: Does the link-shortener rule apply to the supplied short links?
questions.known: Participation Requirements §6(w) bars a shortener used in a way that makes the Amazon destination unclear (SRC-02). The brief does not resolve the status of the supplied links (FLG-003).
questions.missing: A determination for the supplied links.

questions.question: Which license should the repository carry?
questions.known: No license file exists.
questions.missing: Your choice.

questions.question: Do the brief's source IDs (S01, S02, S07, S24, FLG-003, SG-27..SG-30) map to documents?
questions.known: None of these exist in the repository.
questions.missing: The register file.

questions.question: Is PA-API or Creators API access available for product research (price, availability, ratings)?
questions.known: Participation Requirements §2(b) and §6(t) refer to these APIs for price and rating display (SRC-02). Eligibility rules were not read.
questions.missing: Eligibility and application terms.

questions.question: Does the site meet the 'original content' requirement?
questions.known: All guide text was written for this site. It quotes official sources and labels manufacturer claims. Participation Requirements §1 requires original content, with significant commentary on any third-party material (SRC-02).
questions.missing: A reviewer's confirmation.
